output: Sigmoid flame score; not a calibrated confidence.
policy: Fire = flake e dukshme. Tym pa flake eshte No_Fire.
threshold_note: Vendimi ne sherbim perdor 'gates', jo pragun 0.5.

gates.rule: low = pragu me i larte qe mban recall >= 99% per flaken; high = pragu me i ulet qe jep specificity >= 90% mbi jo-flaken. Precision nuk perdoret si cak sepse varet nga perberja e setit. Asnjera porte nuk u pershtat mbi test_final.

calibration_note: Dalja eshte sigmoid, jo probabilitet i kalibruar.
negative_composition_note: Portat u pershtaten pa kuadrot e liqenit. 67.6% e negativave te validation jane liqen, kurse negativat e test_final jane 71.2% pyll me mjegull/tym. Specificity e llogaritur mbi te gjithe negativat e validation eshte optimiste dhe nuk transferohet.
limitation: Development validation and training diagnostics only; no independent test; 201 visually reviewed flame frames repaired; other labels inherited from v1.
